title: Validated Versatility
slide_intent: Test an expressive asset inside a functional screen, because recognition must survive practical interface constraints.
strategic_value: The bowl illustration can connect Sweetgreen’s welcoming voice to the moment a customer chooses food.
demonstration: A phone on a kale background displays the app home screen; an orange ellipse and note emphasize its central illustration.
practical_value: Compare an isolated brand illustration with its prominence and surrounding content inside an app.

content_islands.name: Phone application
content_islands.spec: Place the phone vertically at the center of the kale photograph; retain greeting, food cards and bottom ordering control.

content_islands.name: Review annotation
content_islands.spec: Keep the orange ellipse around the illustration and the accompanying handwritten note.

reference_purposes.Intent: The Validated Versatility caption explains testing across touchpoints to preserve recognition and effectiveness.
reference_purposes.Application: The annotated artwork shows the illustration within an app screen.
